title: control/ is a deterministic state machine; no LLM call belongs there
control and telemetry share one SQLite file but own separate tables and connection helpers
telemetry/normalize.py isolates all runtime-specific event vocabulary behind an adapter
Fast verification is ruff --select F,E9 plus plain __main__ test modules, nothing else
Control plane runs on a Hetzner VM under systemd, not on boxd itself
One GitHub credential serves the control plane and every run VM, and it needs repo + workflow
Goldens are named for the repo, not the agent; the base is golden-copy
Watched repos are a DB register with a sync cache; nothing about a golden gates dispatch
telemetry/config.py's db_path is a plain module attribute, not a frozen settings object
Memory receipts persist from _stream, scanning decoded JSON event text not raw wire lines
A supersession's NEW record goes in domains/ as active; only the OLD one moves to archive/
Admission-control tables (e.g. memory_candidates) live in control/db.py as INSERT OR IGNORE plus an explicit transition-edge dict
CI runs `python -m control.memory validate .` and fails hard if index.jsonl summaries drift from domain record titles
boxd's snapshots.create only queues the capture; reaping the machine aborts it
An index line's files must be evidence.files + dirs, or the record is never retrieved
An empty FACTORY_MEMORY receipt is persisted, and stays provisional until one opens a record
Memory candidates: build-only env var, collected before both reaps, id derived from run + content
